scripts.setup: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run setup && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run start --prefix client"
